dynamic_rules.refferal_reports.r01.d01: office_scope (r01, r02, r05, r06; display-only on r03), referred_from_office_scope (r04, r07) and referred_to_office_scope (r07, r08): the mode radio decides the value key. mode office -> the picker lists offices (lookup:offices) and writes office_ids (list, working_office, my_offices or all); mode office_group -> it lists office groups (lookup:office_groups) and writes office_group_id or office_group_ids (all = every group). Switching the mode resets the selection to that mode's default (working_office / all). Exactly one value key is sent.
dynamic_rules.refferal_reports.r01.d02: Every report of the category: the ADD TO MY FAVORITES action saves the current params as a server-side saved view flagged favorite (report_saved_views, report_favorites). When the caller already holds a favorite for this report_key the action is labelled UPDATE MY FAVORITES and overwrites that favorite's params (legacy: one saved version per report); further named views are an additive enhancement. Shown on every open of the report, from the hub or from My Favorites.

refferal_reports.r01.s02.c02.notes: 108 = id of the office the user was working in. Office attribution on this report: home office of the patient (scope.office_attribution = home_office: rpt_referral_facts.office_id of the inbound_source rows = rpt_patient_dim.home_office_id, current state). Named exception NEW scope.money_leg_office_filter (owner 03 section 5.1 / 02): the money legs of those patients are restricted to the same resolved office set - production, #Proc and # Visits on office of service (rpt_charges.office_id, rpt_visits.office_id); Collection on the allocation office (rpt_payment_allocations.allocation_office_id = office of the paid charge), so only payments allocated to counted charges count; Adjs on rpt_adjustments.office_id. This reproduces the legacy rule 'data limited to the office the report is run in, for patients currently in that office, no cross-office data' when one office is selected [I: whether a payment applied in another office counts is unconfirmed]. With several offices or an office group the result is the union; whether the legacy tool allowed that at all is an open question. Mode office lists offices, mode office_group lists office groups; all = every office the caller may read.

refferal_reports.r01.s03.c01.notes: Primary date range, fixed date_basis = service_date: the date of service of the posted procedures (rpt_charges.service_date) of the referred patients. Production and #Proc count charges with service_date in the range, # Visits counts rpt_visits rows with visit_date in the range; Collection = payments allocated to those charges (PD-3 definition; allocation via rpt_payment_allocations, data card 2.13, PD-7); Adjs = adjustments whose effective service date (coalesce(linked_service_date, transaction_date)) is in the range. Default today in the office time zone.

refferal_reports.r06.s03.c01.notes: Primary date range, fixed date_basis = service_date. On this report the range defines 'seen': a referred patient is counted once per referral source when at least one rpt_visits row (patient-office-day with a live visit-code production charge, data card 2.17, the one definition of legacy 'Patients Seen') has visit_date in the range and an office of the set (default count_basis = visit). A contract instalment, a broken-appointment fee or another non-visit charge alone does not count. Presumed - vendor text says only 'referred patients seen in the period'; confirm on the live legacy tool whether a kept appointment without a posted procedure also counts. Default today in the office time zone.

refferal_reports.r03.s04.c01.notes: On Referral Source List this filters the type of the referral-source row itself (legacy setup field Type), not a patient. DentC referrals has no such column today (referrals.referral_type holds the by/to direction code '0'/'1'): NEW column referrals.source_type_code, owner 03_data_foundation.md (extension of DATA-40), back-filled for the 665 migrated sources from the legacy referral-source export by referrals.legacy_id. Until it exists only ALL returns rows and any type choice prints the availability[] warning referral_source_type_unavailable. Legacy single-select; list accepted (enhancement). Options: definitions:referral_type.

refferal_reports.r03.s03.c01.notes: Static dropdown captured collapsed: only the default ALL is known. Filters the source on its Referred by/To setting; the footer echoes a code (99 = all). Candidate options to confirm on the live legacy tool (labels and order): ALL -> all, Referred By -> referred_by, Referred To -> referred_to, Both -> both. Proposed until confirmed: Referred By and Referred To also select sources set to Both; Both selects only Both sources. DentC stores the direction in referrals.referral_type ('0' / '1'); 'Both' has no stored value today and the migration loaded all 665 sources as referred by (NEW three-valued direction with back-fill, owner 03, DATA-40 extension); until then Both prints the warning referral_direction_both_unavailable.
